Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for Zimbabwe's reply! Scotland's players have made their way out in the middle, followed by Zimbabwe openers, Wesley Madhevere and Tadiwanashe Marumani. Safyaan Sharif to start with the ball.
....THE RUN CHASE....
Right then! Zimbabwe have to get 142 from 20 overs if they are to win this match and go 1-0 up in the series. Do join us for the chase in a while as it promises to be an exciting one.

Zimbabwe would be slightly disappointed with their bowling effort after having started brilliantly with the ball, especially in the Powerplay. Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava, and Luke Jongwe were the pick of the bowlers as they took 5 wickets in between them and hardly gave any freebies to Scotland's batters. They would feel that they could have done slightly better in the middle overs but they will be reasonably happy with the total they have to chase. Zimbabwe were excellent in the field as well as they took a couple of brilliant catches.

Scotland did not get off to a great start as they lost four wickets in the Powerplay for just 30 runs and were on the back foot. Richie Berrington coming in at number 4, played a fantastic innings for his side and steadied the ship along with his partner Calum Macleod. Richie kept losing partners but that did not stop him from scoring freely and took his team to a competitive total in the end, as he finished on an unbeaten 82 and helped Scotland post 141.

This has been a really good comeback from Scotland as after losing four wickets in the Powerplay., they have bounced back and have ended on a good total. Zimbabwe would be a touch disappointed with the way they bowled after the Powerplay, but they would have taken this score at the start of the innings.

Hello and welcome to the first T20I of the three-match series between Scotland and Zimbabwe. Scotland would be eagerly looking forward to this T20I series and they will be taking this as a good opportunity to get some game-time before the all-important T20 World Cup. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, are coming into this series having lost their previous one against Ireland and they too would be keen to step out onto the field and turn things around against Scotland. It promises to be an exciting contest. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.
